title: ApiImportCurlResult
description: Result of the api.import.curl JSON-RPC method: one pasted curl command line converted into a request, plus what the conversion did not carry over. The line is PARSED, never executed (design §10) — there is no shell, so $(...) and backticks are literal text rather than a substitution that has to be defended against — and an import never fires a request: this returns a request value, and sending it is a separate gesture.

unsupported.description: Never null — a line that converted whole is [].
